## 更新内容 / Changes

- 修复创建实例绑定 ChatGPT 登录账号时默认模型和模型下拉为空的问题。空账号模型列表现在使用客户端可见模型目录，并按目录推荐顺序自动选择默认模型，无需手动填写即可继续。
- 供应商 API 连接继续使用自己的模型列表；不将原生模型注入供应商配置。手动填写、编辑和复制实例时的已有模型保持原样，较晚返回的目录结果不会覆盖用户选择。
- 模型候选不代表账号权限检测，实际可用性仍由上游账号决定；可继续手动填写模型 ID。

- Fixed empty default-model fields and model choices when creating an instance with a ChatGPT login account. Accounts without a stored model list now use visible client-catalog models, with the recommended default selected automatically.
- Provider API connections keep their own model lists. Typed models and saved models in edited or copied instances are preserved; late catalog results cannot overwrite a user selection.
- Catalog choices are not an account-entitlement probe. Availability depends on the upstream account, and manual model IDs remain supported.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。安装前停止实例并退出旧管理器；账号、实例与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Stop instances and quit the old manager before installing; accounts, instances and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

当前支持 Codex。Claude Code、Claude Desktop 及其他客户端仍为计划接入。客户端需单独安装；界面兼容与 Fast 的实际支持取决于客户端、模型和供应商。

Codex is currently supported. Claude Code, Claude Desktop and other clients remain planned integrations. Clients must be installed separately; UI compatibility and Fast depend on the client, model and provider.

源码对应标签 [`v0.4.4`](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/tree/v0.4.4)，安装包校验值见附件 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。

Source corresponds to tag [`v0.4.4`](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/tree/v0.4.4); installer checksums are in the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
